blockers.quote: treasure in the soil worth more than ten rupees is reported and deposited with the Collector, and not reporting can mean up to a year in prison, under an Act from 1878
blockers.why: Check #7, Misconception first: this lands three numbers in one fact beat.
blockers.fix: Replace with: "Under an old Indian law, treasure found in soil must be reported and deposited with the Collector."

blockers.quote: You whisper. The old line snaps off; a new one, 6.1 m, crosses the wet courtyard to the white tablet by the crooked tulsi.
blockers.why: Check #6, Every use has a gap: the power produces exactly the requested and expected result.
blockers.fix: Replace with: "You expect the line to cross the courtyard. Instead it loops back to a tear in his kurta lining: the tablet was inside the pocket he had patted three times."

blockers.quote: Your mother's earring, lost eight years ago by the courtyard drain: the line goes up the neem tree to a crow's nest, where it sits with three other people's earrings. Sunday lunch at 1:15: grandfather's same story
blockers.why: Check #5, But / therefore: the first-jump montage moves from the earring to lunch, the bazaar and the hearing aid without causal turns.
blockers.fix: Move Sunday lunch before the searches, then chain them: the bicycle gives no line; therefore you test the earring; the crow's nest contains strangers' jewellery; therefore you take one to the bazaar; but a drain washer is already searching there; then the old man's request leads to Madhav.

suggestions.quote: The whole sea is on your line. Drop it, for one pill?
suggestions.fix: Make abandoning a line irreversible in the rule stated before 0:30; otherwise the sea can simply be queried again after finding the pill and the dilemma is false.

suggestions.quote: Every lost thing on Earth has a line waiting.
suggestions.fix: Make one query ethically harder, not merely larger: plant a private object the grandmother deliberately discarded, then let its line appear during this sequence.

suggestions.quote: you and your cousin mouth it along with him
suggestions.fix: Add one plainly warm action here—for example, Grandfather silently saves you the best mango slice—so the later rupture costs more than the family anecdote.

keep.quote: Some things stay lost. Keeps the peace.
Knowing where was never the hard part
The earth goes back; the tulsi goes back in crooked
